mapper.sql: WITH latest_match AS ( SELECT ppm.PRODUCT_NO, ps.AVG_PRICE, ppm.SAVING_RATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ppm.PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY ps.SNAPSHOT_DATE DESC, ps.SNAPSHOT_NO DESC ) AS rn FROM OFT_PRODUCT_PRICE_MATCH ppm JOIN OFT_PRICE_SNAPSHOT ps ON ps.SNAPSHOT_NO = ppm.SNAPSHOT_NO )
mapper.select: SELECT CART_NO FROM OFT_CART WHERE USER_NO = #{_parameter} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT ci.CART_ITEM_NO AS cartItemNo, ci.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, ci.QUANTITY AS quantity FROM OFT_CART c JOIN OFT_CART_ITEM ci ON ci.CART_NO = c.CART_NO WHERE c.USER_NO = #{_parameter} ORDER BY ci.CREATED_AT ASC, ci.CART_ITEM_NO ASC

SELECT ci.CART_ITEM_NO AS cartItemNo, c.CART_NO AS cartNo, p.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, p.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, p.SALE_PRICE AS salePrice, p.STOCK_QTY AS stockQty, p.SALE_STATUS AS saleStatus, lm.AVG_PRICE AS avgPrice, lm.SAVING_RATE AS savingRate, GREATEST(NVL(lm.AVG_PRICE, 0) - p.SALE_PRICE, 0) * ci.QUANTITY AS savedAmount, ci.QUANTITY AS quantity FROM OFT_CART c JOIN OFT_CART_ITEM ci ON ci.CART_NO = c.CART_NO JOIN OFT_PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_NO = ci.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN latest_match lm ON lm.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO AND lm.rn = 1 WHERE c.USER_NO = #{_parameter} ORDER BY ci.CREATED_AT ASC, ci.CART_ITEM_NO ASC

SELECT ci.CART_ITEM_NO AS cartItemNo, ci.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, ci.QUANTITY AS quantity FROM OFT_CART c JOIN OFT_CART_ITEM ci ON ci.CART_NO = c.CART_NO WHERE c.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND ci.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OFT_CART_ITEM (CART_NO, PRODUCT_NO, QUANTITY) VALUES (#{cartNo}, #{productNo}, #{quantity})
